route: Per take: 3 OmniHuman 1.5 candidates (still / eyes / smooth prompts) from the locked still + exact slice; keep the one with the lowest head motion whose hand stutter and jerk are no worse than the r9 reference; crop to 1920x1080 at native 25 fps; Seedance 2.5 with K01 + that reference (r10 prompt); react-1 lips/neutral/0.5/cut_off; conform 24 fps.

prompts.still: The man speaks directly to the camera, seated at the wooden table. His head stays almost still, facing the lens, with only tiny natural movement. Warm, attentive eyes with ordinary blinks. Relaxed breathing in the chest and shoulders, and one or two slow, small hand gestures that lift slightly off the table and settle. Fixed camera, same wide framing. No exaggerated expressions, no fast or jerky movements, no finger pointing.
prompts.eyes: The man speaks directly to the camera, seated at the wooden table, calm and sincere. His eyes carry the expression: warm and alive, responding to the words with small brow lifts and slight squints on emphasis, ordinary blinks. The head stays steady with small natural movement. The body is calm: gentle breathing in the chest and shoulders, hands mostly resting with an occasional small gesture. Fixed camera, same wide framing. No exaggerated expressions, no fast or jerky movements, no finger pointing.
prompts.smooth: The man speaks directly to the camera, seated at the wooden table, relaxed and unhurried. Slow, smooth, continuous movement only: gentle breathing in the chest and shoulders, a slight shoulder shift on emphasis, and one or two slow hand gestures that rise and settle smoothly. The head stays calm with small movement. Warm, engaged eyes with ordinary blinks. Fixed camera, same wide framing. No exaggerated expressions, no fast or jerky movements, no finger pointing.
